verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents uploading files or building a knowledge base that the AI retrieves from to give grounded answers. Persistent agent memory, Pages with shared context, a Note composer mode, and Skills' 'supporting material' are adjacent features, not a user-attachable knowledge base. This is an applicable axis for an AI chat product, so missing evidence means 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a power user, I can attach my own documents and notes as a knowledge base and get grounded answers over them
